DUSACCOM · WEBSITE POLICIES

Terms of Service

Website terms · October 23, 2026

Using this website

This website introduces the Dominican USA Chamber of Commerce and its business community. Please use the website lawfully and respectfully. Do not attempt to disrupt the site or misuse its forms.

Membership and programs

Membership pathways and program descriptions are proposed introductory information. Current membership dues, benefits, eligibility, services, and availability must be confirmed directly with DUSACCOM. Preparing or sending an inquiry does not establish membership or a partnership.

Events and registration

Program previews are expressions of interest only. Dates, locations, admission, and registration details will be confirmed separately. An event inquiry does not reserve a place or create a registration.

No online payments

This website does not collect payments, request card details, or enter visitors into a paid agreement. Any future payment or membership agreement must be reviewed and accepted separately.

Information and resources

Website resources provide general business information. They are not individualized professional advice or a guarantee of business results. Confirm details and seek appropriate professional support for your circumstances.

Contact

For questions or to verify the latest details, contact dusaccom1@gmail.com or call 646-326-6052.
